summary.business_type: Solo consultancy / professional service (Angular & frontend engineering) with publisher signals
top_findings: Internal link equity flows to case studies (up to 15 contextual inbound) while service pages get only 2-4
Apex domain has a 2-hop redirect chain: http://rabinr.in -> https://rabinr.in -> https://www.rabinr.in
Duplicate hero image preload on homepage (manual hoist in page.tsx now redundant with React auto-hoisting)
Performance could not be measured - PageSpeed returned 429, no CrUX field data available
quick_wins: Collapse apex redirect to a single hop
Delete redundant preload block in src/app/page.tsx
Add width/height to the one unsized img on /, /contact, /process
Lengthen 5 under-length titles (16-20 chars) to carry query terms
Remove or nofollow the sitewide footer link to noindex /version

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: All 30 URLs return 200 with self-referencing canonicals
robots.txt correct with Host and Sitemap directives
HSTS includeSubDomains preload, X-Frame-Options DENY, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy
404 returns proper status; /version and /maintenance correctly noindex and excluded from sitemap

findings.title: Two-hop redirect chain on apex domain
findings.recommendation: Redirect http://rabinr.in directly to https://www.rabinr.in at the Vercel domain layer

findings.title: Sitewide footer link to noindex page
findings.description: /version is linked on 29 of 30 pages but is noindex, follow
findings.recommendation: Remove from footer or add rel=nofollow

findings.title: No Content-Security-Policy header
findings.description: Five other security headers are set; CSP is absent
findings.recommendation: Add a CSP header to complete the security header set

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Strong E-E-A-T: named government and pension systems, specific metrics, real resume
Articles take positions drawn from shipped work rather than summarising documentation

findings.title: Thin hub and commercial pages
findings.recommendation: Expand /insights by 300-400 words stating topical scope and perspective

findings.title: Six short case studies
findings.description: RESOLVED: now 645-762 words against a 778-word benchmark. The gap was three missing fields (responsibilities, metrics, decisions), not prose length.
findings.recommendation: Review the added decisions for factual accuracy; metrics left empty pending verified numbers.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Zero duplicate titles or descriptions across 30 pages
All meta descriptions 132-172 chars and hand-written
Exactly one H1 per page; OG and Twitter card tags on all pages

findings.title: Internal link equity flows to case studies, not service pages
findings.description: Contextual inbound links: fiji-immigration-internal 15, prims-member-portal 10, versus angular-performance-optimization 2 and ionic-development 3
findings.recommendation: Link from each case study to the service page it demonstrates; target 6+ contextual inbound links per service page

findings.title: Five under-length titles
findings.recommendation: Extend to carry query terms within the ~60 character allowance

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Person, WebSite, ProfessionalService sitewide plus BreadcrumbList, Service, CreativeWork, BlogPosting, ProfilePage, ItemList, Blog

findings.title: FAQPage on homepage inconsistent with documented service-page decision
findings.description: JsonLd.tsx:192 emits FAQPage while ServiceNarrative.tsx documents deliberately omitting it. Google retired FAQ rich results for all sites on 2026-05-07.
findings.recommendation: No removal needed - it earns nothing but costs nothing. Reconcile the two decisions deliberately.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Hero poster with responsive imageSrcSet and fetchPriority high
WebP throughout; loading=lazy on 10 of 17 homepage images

findings.title: Duplicate hero image preload
findings.description: Two link rel=preload as=image tags for the same poster srcset: React auto-hoists one from ScrollVideoPlayer.tsx:217-223 and src/app/page.tsx:19-30 adds a manual one
findings.recommendation: Delete the manual preload block in src/app/page.tsx, then verify exactly one preload remains in the rendered head - revert if zero remain

findings.title: Homepage payload 291KB
findings.description: Roughly 71KB inline script across 25 blocks, 19 JS chunks, 3 stylesheets; next heaviest page is 152KB
findings.recommendation: Acceptable for App Router; revisit only after field data confirms an LCP problem

findings.title: Performance not measured
findings.description: PageSpeed Insights returned HTTP 429 (anonymous quota exhausted) and no CrUX field data was available. This score is inferred from payload evidence only.
findings.recommendation: Obtain a PageSpeed API key or read Core Web Vitals from Search Console before further performance work

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: AI crawlers unblocked - no GPTBot, ClaudeBot or PerplexityBot restrictions
llms.txt present and well-structured with grouped key pages
Articles carry concrete numbers, named systems and BlogPosting schema

findings.title: Service pages lack a quotable standalone answer
findings.description: Articles answer engineering questions well, but service pages never state the hiring answer plainly up front
findings.recommendation: Open each service page with 2-3 self-contained sentences answering who it is for, what is done, and one number

categories.name: Images
what_works: Zero missing alt attributes across all 30 pages
WebP with responsive srcset, lazy loading below the fold, fetchpriority on the LCP candidate

findings.title: Withdrawn: three images missing dimensions
findings.description: Originally reported as a CLS risk. All three are absolutely-positioned fill images (hero poster via hero.css; /contact and /process via Next.js Image fill), which cannot shift layout and are specified to carry no width/height.

phases.name: Phase 1: Highest Leverage
items: Redistribute internal links from case studies to service pages [DONE]
Collapse apex domain redirect to a single hop [NOT DONE - Vercel dashboard]
Remove redundant hero preload in src/app/page.tsx and verify one remains [DONE]

phases.name: Phase 2: Content Depth
items: DONE: quotable answer paragraph on all 4 service pages
DONE (needs factual sign-off): six short case studies deepened to 645-762 words via decisions; metrics deliberately left empty as no verified numbers exist

phases.name: Phase 3: Measurement
items: Get a PageSpeed API key or Search Console CWV report to replace inferred performance data
Install Python 3.10+ and run /seo setup to unlock rendered-DOM crawling and PDF reports
Housekeeping DONE: 5 titles lengthened, /version nofollowed, CSP added Report-Only, FAQPage decision documented. Image-dimension item withdrawn as a false positive.

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring
items: Capture a drift baseline for deploy-to-deploy comparison
Track Search Console impressions for /services/* as the Phase 1 success signal
Re-audit once field data is available
